paragraph propulsion, turns, emphasis, handoff, and local flow

POV, focalization, knowledge boundaries, and narrative distance
character goals, agency, continuity, and relationship pressure

scene tension, causality, reversals, and consequence
pacing, compression, expansion, dwell time, and edit-budget fit
information release, reader questions, withholding, and orientation burden
description, sensory selection, imagery, metaphor, and motif dosage

activation_rules.THEOLOGICAL_PHILOSOPHICAL_REASONING: activate only when theological/philosophical constraints or passage purpose make it relevant
activation_rules.HISTORICAL_REGISTER: activate only when historical constraints or period-register claims are relevant
activation_rules.OPENING_ENDING_TURNS: activate only at passage/scene/chapter boundary when turn function is relevant

global_rules: Specialists diagnose and produce evidence; they do not rewrite.
A specialist cannot override canon, protected language, authorial intent, POV knowledge boundaries, or explicit user constraints.
Specialist agreement is evidence, not truth; correlated findings must not be counted as independent votes.
Named-author similarity is never a specialist target.
